{"assessments":[{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"文本给出了按运动基础区分练习时长、配合歌曲节奏练习的具体建议，并现场引入示范；但效果依赖未提供的动作画面。","candidate_id":"candidate_2e7f0f8e0e88fae2","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["visual_verification_required"],"primary_claim":"练习者可按运动基础选择不同练习时长，并配合有节奏的歌曲完成训练。","risk_summary":"包含运动时长建议，且具体动作是否安全、规范需要结合未提供的画面审核。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"按运动基础安排节奏训练","uncertainty_flags":["visual_dependency"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选明确反对“狗哈气”练法并推荐另一种练习，还作出一周必有进步和练不坏的绝对承诺；练习名称存在明显识别不确定性。","candidate_id":"candidate_27095253c085da43","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim","sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain"],"primary_claim":"相比“狗哈气”，主播推荐一种自称更稳妥的练习，并宣称坚持一周就会进步。","risk_summary":"练习名称可能识别有误，且包含不会练坏、一定进步等绝对安全与效果承诺，并带有课程推广语境。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":2,"hook_strength":3,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"替代“狗哈气”的声乐练习","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"文本通过教师学员和主播自身的体验说明发声方法也能用于日常讲话，并穿插“开门”的声音示范；关于呼吸位置的部分依赖动作展示且表述略含混。","candidate_id":"candidate_f1d87e3d981d87dc","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["visual_verification_required"],"primary_claim":"学习合适的发声与气息运用后，日常长时间讲话也可能更轻松。","risk_summary":"涉及嗓音状态改善的经验性主张，呼吸位置和示范效果还依赖未提供的画面。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"将声乐发声方法用于日常讲话","uncertainty_flags":["visual_dependency"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"可辨认的内容主要是欢迎观众、感谢陪伴并调整直播灯光，表达完整但信息价值和独立传播吸引力较弱。","candidate_id":"candidate_835027c32b145c6e","content_risk_flags":[],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["visual_verification_required"],"primary_claim":"主播认为当前灯光缺乏明暗对比，因此进行调整并征询观众感受。","risk_summary":"对灯光效果的判断需要画面验证。","scores":{"content_value":1,"editorial_utility":1,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":1,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"直播问候与灯光调整","uncertainty_flags":["visual_dependency"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选从“长音唱不久”的问题出发，给出胸腔过度用力会缩短持续时间的解释，并强调自然发声和逐项练习，观点有明确闭合。","candidate_id":"candidate_c26a4653242fd277","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"唱长音时过度用力可能更快耗尽气息，应减少不必要的控制并逐项练习。","risk_summary":"包含关于发声用力与嗓音训练的安全和效果建议。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"长音练习中过度用力的问题","uncertainty_flags":[],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"核心观点是扩大舌根与上颚之间的空间有助于高音，并用抬舌后的声音作对比；部分词语识别异常，且口腔位置和示范效果依赖画面。","candidate_id":"candidate_a7de7d24d9c2d27c","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain","visual_verification_required"],"primary_claim":"主播认为舌根与上颚之间保留更大空间，能减少高音卡紧。","risk_summary":"局部转写存在歧义，口腔位置与声音对比需要画面和音频复核，且涉及发声训练建议。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":2,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"舌位与高音发声空间","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity","visual_dependency"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"文本提供了按基础分配练习时间、避免一次练太久以及分散练习的具体方案，但后段转入直播互动和一对一教学推广，主题略有混杂。","candidate_id":"candidate_4305cfa07f8b1fbf","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim","sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"训练应按基础控制时长，想增加练习量时宜分开进行，而非一次持续过久。","risk_summary":"包含训练时长与效果建议，结尾还带有一对一教学推广内容。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":3,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"分散安排日常训练时长","uncertainty_flags":["mixed_topics"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选清楚解释了刻意控制舌头可能导致舌根发力，并给出放松和轻触下牙齿后方的替代做法，结构完整且便于剪辑。","candidate_id":"candidate_2efa31efddfe10ed","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"唱歌时不应刻意挤压或强行控制舌头，实在找不到位置时可让舌尖轻触下牙齿后方。","risk_summary":"包含具体口腔位置和发声用力建议，需要进行嗓音训练安全审核。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":4,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"唱歌时的舌头放松与摆位","uncertainty_flags":[],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"主播以当天连续讲话多小时但没有沙哑为例，区分正常疲惫与嗓音受损，并将结果归因于其所称的科学发声通道；论据主要是个人经验。","candidate_id":"candidate_1b8b4323d05c7dd6","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim","sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"主播认为正确的发声方法不仅适用于唱歌，也能让长时间讲话后只感到疲惫而不易沙哑。","risk_summary":"嗓音保护效果主要来自个人陈述，并带有对其教学方法的推广意味。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"长时间讲话中的嗓音保护","uncertainty_flags":[],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选用学员从怀疑到报名的经历证明教学价值，具备故事转折；但学员身份、品牌名称和部分表述识别不清，结尾又切换到不教喊麦。","candidate_id":"candidate_d3981771b1792fc6","content_risk_flags":["sponsor_or_advertising","reputation_or_defamation"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain"],"primary_claim":"主播讲述一名原本质疑其教学的学员在体验课程并感到进步后继续报名。","risk_summary":"内容属于课程效果见证和推广，涉及未经核实的第三方评价与身份信息，且品牌名称可能转写不准。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":2,"hook_strength":3,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"学员从质疑到报名的课程见证","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity","mixed_topics"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"前段可辨认出戏曲与流行唱法在咬字、嘴型上不同而气息相通的观点，后段混入关注引导和美声难度讨论，且若干词句转写不稳定。","candidate_id":"candidate_3c76eb79d4264624","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain"],"primary_claim":"不同唱法的咬字和嘴型会变化，但主播认为其气息基础可以相通。","risk_summary":"部分声乐术语转写不清，并含有练习不会出错的绝对效果表述。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":2,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"戏曲、流行与美声的发声差异","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity","mixed_topics"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"low","assessment_reason":"仍可辨认出后续将安排观众连麦诊断，并引导加入粉丝群体，但大量重复、错词和无关片段使主线不稳定，独立编辑需要较多整理。","candidate_id":"candidate_7d8b0df1b19a1ead","content_risk_flags":["sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain","incomplete_claim"],"primary_claim":"主播预告稍后会开放连麦，为观众进行问题诊断，并穿插粉丝互动引导。","risk_summary":"转写受损且内容不完整，同时带有粉丝互动和直播推广信息。","scores":{"content_value":1,"editorial_utility":1,"evidence_fidelity":1,"hook_strength":1,"standalone_completeness":1},"topic_hypothesis":"连麦诊断预告与粉丝互动","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity","mixed_topics","claim_ambiguity"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"文本用同一句歌词的两种唱法对比漏气现象，解释为何练过气息仍觉得不够，并提出气息与发声通道应结合训练，信息具体且闭合。","candidate_id":"candidate_a5c87afa0254618e","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim","copyright_or_third_party"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"胸腔共鸣处理不当会造成漏气，因此气息与发声通道应结合练习。","risk_summary":"包含具体发声训练建议，并引用和演示了第三方歌曲片段。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":4,"hook_strength":3,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"胸腔共鸣导致漏气的原因","uncertainty_flags":[],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选完整呈现了直播授课之后复制学员视频、剪辑进步片段、沟通协作以及继续制作内容的工作链条，能独立体现幕后工作量。","candidate_id":"candidate_c0638f35973b6082","content_risk_flags":["personal_data"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"直播授课只是工作的一部分，课后还要处理学员视频、沟通对接并制作次日内容。","risk_summary":"提到复制、发送和剪辑学员视频，发布前应确认相关素材的隐私与授权。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"教学直播背后的课后工作","uncertainty_flags":[],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"前半段明确对比单纯喊叫与借助发声通道唱高音，形成直接问题和答案；后半段转向年龄相关机能退化与健身，削弱了主题集中度。","candidate_id":"candidate_638470bcf20511aa","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim","sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"高音不应靠用力喊上去，而应学习运用发声通道、腔体和位置。","risk_summary":"包含嗓音训练与年龄相关身体机能主张，同时将方法与付费技术课程价值相联系。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":3,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"高音需要发声通道而非硬喊","uncertainty_flags":["mixed_topics"],"unusable_reason":"none"}]}
